stem.text: A ball of mass $0.16\,\text{kg}$ is travelling horizontally at a speed of $20\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
It collides with a wall and rebounds with a speed of $15\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ along its original path. The ball is in contact with the wall for a time of $1.0\,\text{ms}$.
What is the average force exerted by the wall on the ball?
